newsitem.title: GREECE: DRACHMA BOUYANT VS ECU, BREAKS 309 AT MID-SESSION.
newsitem.headline: DRACHMA BOUYANT VS ECU, BREAKS 309 AT MID-SESSION.

text.p: The drachma continued to gain ground against the ecu around mid-session, breaking the 309 barrier on the downside as stop-losses were trigerred, dealers said.

"Some investors who were long ecu/drachma rushed to close out positions while others opted to open fresh short ecu, long drachma positions," a forex dealer at a foreign bank said. "The sentiment for the drachma has improved a lot after the statement."
A high-level central bank official told Reuters that Bank of Greece wanted the drachma broadly stable against major EMS currencies in 1997 to facilitate its anti-inflationary crusade.
The official also said ecu/drachma moves in recent weeks reflected the strength of the pound sterling.
Ecu/drachma opened at 309.25/30 to hit an intraday low of 308.85 before bouncing up to 308.98-309.03. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
